title: EMU just below 250 km/h
why: 249 km/h: the cab row is the one below 250 km/h, and the 250 km/h pass-by does not apply.

noise.cab_max_speed_db.rationale: Noise TSI 4.2.4 Table 5 (cab, for units fitted with a cab: standstill with horns 95 dB; at vmax 78 dB if vmax < 250 km/h, 80 dB if 250 ≤ vmax < 350 km/h): 249 < 250, so 78 dB; 78 ≤ 78.

noise.pass_by_250_db.rationale: Noise TSI 4.2.3 Table 4 (80 km/h: electric locomotives 84, diesel 85, EMUs 80, DMUs 81, coaches 79, wagons 83 dB; 250 km/h, if applicable: electric locomotives 99, EMUs 95, DMUs 96 dB): design speed 249 < 250, so the 250 km/h limit does not apply.
